message.content:
In AI agents, memory manifests as a context management challenge where accumulating conversation histories and tool outputs cause system failures.  
In Roman material culture, memory was physically inscribed on funerary steles erected to commemorate deceased soldiers.  
In classical mythology, memory was personified as the goddess Mnemosyne.
